Data Scientist

Location: Manchester, Exchange Quays
Working pattern: Hybrid- 2 days a week on site
Department: Technology
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join an ambitious technology business in Manchester, working at the intersection of data science, AI, behavioural insights and technology.

You'll join the Insight Services team, working alongside experienced Data Scientists to develop the data pipelines, analytical models and AI products that sit behind a growing technology platform.

This is a hands-on role combining data science, R development and data engineering in AWS. You'll have the opportunity to work across the full data lifecycle, from collecting and transforming data through to building models, deploying solutions and supporting them in production.

Around 80% of your time will be focused on AI product development, data engineering and product enhancement, with the remaining 20% focused on Level 3 technical support.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that collect, clean and transform customer and internal data

  • Develop data analysis and statistical models using R

  • Build, test and maintain machine learning and predictive models

  • Develop and deploy R-based applications and data workflows within AWS

  • Work with structured and unstructured data to identify trends, patterns and insights

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines and data workflows

  • Work with AWS services including S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS, Glue and CloudWatch

  • Monitor data quality, pipeline performance and production issues

  • Design and maintain data models and database schemas

  • Write efficient SQL queries and work with relational databases

  • Use Git, testing and version control to produce reliable and maintainable code

  • Create data visualisations and communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Translate business challenges into analytical questions and evidence-based solutions

  • Support behavioural and risk segmentation, research and cost analysis

  • Provide Level 3 technical support, investigating and resolving complex application and data issues

  • Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation and continuous improvement

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone with around 1-2 years of commercial experience who has exposure to both the analytical and engineering sides of data.

You'll need:

  • 1+ years' commercial experience in data analysis or data science

  • 1+ years' commercial experience developing in R using RStudio / Posit

  • Strong working knowledge of statistics and machine learning

  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines

  • Practical experience working with AWS, ideally including S3 and a managed database service such as RDS

  • Strong SQL skills

  • Experience working with a relational database such as MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server

  • Experience writing reusable, tested code

  • Experience using Git and version control

R experience is mandatory for this role.

Desirable experience

It would be beneficial if you also have experience with:

  • MySQL

  • Python

  • Docker and containerisation

  • CI/CD pipelines

  • Terraform or CloudFormation

  • Airflow, AWS Step Functions or other workflow orchestration tools

  • Building APIs or packaging models in R, such as plumber or R packages

  • SaaS or software product environments

  • Customer-facing or application support

  • Social Housing data, research or analytics

About you

You'll be analytical, curious and comfortable getting hands-on with data and code.

You'll enjoy solving problems, understanding how data can improve decision-making and learning new technologies. You'll also be comfortable explaining technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and working collaboratively with more experienced members of the team.

We're particularly interested in people who demonstrate:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Good mathematical and statistical ability

  • Excellent attention to detail

  • A passion for data science, software development and well-engineered data systems

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • A willingness to learn and take feedback

  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks

A degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or another technical discipline would be beneficial, although equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.

Why join?

You'll be joining a growing technology business where data science and AI are central to the products being developed.

The role offers the chance to work across R, machine learning, AWS, data engineering and AI, while learning directly from experienced Data Scientists and contributing to products used to solve real-world challenges across sectors including Social Housing, Local Government and Healthcare.

If you're an early-career Data Scientist who wants to build strong commercial experience across both data science and data engineering, this is an opportunity to develop a broad and highly valuable technical skillset.

Help build and scale practical AI solutions that solve real business problems
We're working with an organisation that is investing heavily in AI and automation and is looking for an AI Engineer to join a growing team. This is an opportunity to work on projects that move beyond experimentation, taking AI solutions from proof of concept into production and delivering measurable business impact.

This role would suit someone with a software engineering background who has started building experience with AI technologies and wants to accelerate their development within a supportive engineering environment.

The Role
As an AI Engineer, you'll work across the full solution lifecycle, helping to design, build and deploy AI-powered applications whilst ensuring the underlying integrations, data and processes are robust and scalable.
You'll be involved in:

  • Building AI-enabled solutions such as conversational assistants, workflow automation and intelligent document processing
  • Developing applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agent-based approaches
  • Taking solutions from prototype through to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement
  • Building and maintaining APIs, integrations and data pipelines that support AI applications
  • Working closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions
  • Supporting user testing, rollout and adoption of new AI capabilities
  • Contributing to engineering standards, testing, documentation and CI/CD practices

What We're Looking For
Essential Experience

  • Experience in software engineering, application development, APIs, integrations or data pipelines
  • Strong programming skills in Python or a similar language
  • Exposure to Large Language Models, prompting, model APIs or AI applications through commercial work, study or personal projects
  • Experience working with SQL and real-world data
  • Experience deploying solutions into cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Demonstrable ability to learn new technologies quickly

Desirable Experience

  • Agentic AI or AI agent frameworks
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Workflow automation platforms
  • AI evaluation, monitoring or observability
  • Experience working within regulated environments
  • Agile delivery experience

About YouThis organisation is placing particular emphasis on mindset and potential.

You'll likely be:

  • Curious and passionate about learning new technologies
  • Pragmatic and focused on delivering value rather than chasing perfection
  • Interested in understanding business problems as well as technical challenges
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities
  • Open to feedback and continuous improvement
  • Honest about the opportunities and limitations of AI
  • Someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions

If you're excited by the prospect of helping build practical AI solutions whilst developing your own expertise in a rapidly evolving field, we'd love to hear from you.

This company is a Workflow & AI Orchestration Specialist. They deliver workflow and orchestration solutions that modernise casework, data, and citizen services. They connect fragmented systems to create coherent experiences with AI agents deployed safely at scale. They operate across two pillars: 1) advise and implement to provide end-to-end technology solutions that integrate cutting edge orchestration and 2) agentic AI capabilities. They’re growing fast and looking for bright, dynamic people to help build their business.


Role Overview


They're looking for an AI Builder to join their growing team: someone who builds AI and agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems. They’re looking for someone who can help solve both these questions. First and foremost, they’re looking for someone who can help build these systems. Historically this would have required candidates with a deep understanding of machine learning and AI engineering, but in the new world of agentic coding and high-performance generalised reasoning models, things are clearly a little different.


They build solutions using a combination of APIs, self-hosted models, agentic frameworks and agentic builders integrated into other technology solutions. They use third party products and integrations where useful, but they also design and build their own bespoke systems either when the problem requires or when it makes sense commercially. They generally build their backend systems in Python, although increasingly leverage agentic coding tools so that they are less in the weeds of coding itself, and more building at the system level.


Core to all of this is being able to navigate complex but often poorly defined and open-ended questions effectively. They are looking for candidates who can build solutions quickly and efficiently whilst ensuring these systems are well designed and extensible, who can balance speed with engineering quality and ensure they avoid overengineering solutions too early whilst then productionising and scaling solutions effectively when proven, who can work closely with clients and end users to understand problems whilst iterating towards desired outcomes, and who remain curious and motivated across a rapidly evolving technology and business landscape.


They expect candidates to be comparatively stronger across different areas depending on background and experience, and they are happy to consider candidates from a diverse range of backgrounds from both academia and industry. This includes machine learning and AI engineers, software developers who are looking to focus more on AI, product designers and architects who are looking to move into more technical delivery, and technical researchers (physics, mathematics, computer science etc.) who want to move into more applied development and delivery.


They are also open to different levels of experience and seniority, which is reflected in the relatively wide salary bracket. Most important is experience and interest in building these systems in some form, some level of technical understanding and experience, and curiosity and motivation to continue to learn how to build effective AI and agentic systems.


Key Responsibilities


  • Working directly with the Head of AI & Data to design, develop, deploy and scale AI and agentic AI systems that solve real-world problems, both for clients and internally.
  • Collaborate with service designers, engineers and business analysts to identify and frame AI use cases.
  • Build rapid proof-of-concepts (PoC) and prototype AI systems to demonstrate possible solutions, test technical feasibility, gain feedback on design and gauge overall usefulness.
  • Work with engineering teams to productionise and scale AI and agentic systems within wider products and platforms.
  • Iterate and improve AI and agentic systems already deployed within client organisations and internally to improve performance, quality, robustness, resilience, cost etc. and to further extend features.
  • Build solutions using agentic coding tools, with a strong eye on system design and quality.
  • Advise on AI strategy, adoption and scaling for clients.
  • Contribute to internal R&D, tooling, thought leadership and the company’s AI proposition.
  • Support bids and client engagements where AI capability is a key differentiator.
  • Help maintain awareness of and critically analyse the evolving AI landscape, both at a model / product level and more at a business / strategic level.


Essential Skills and Experience


  • Demonstrable experience building systems that incorporate AI and/or agentic AI, whether that’s in industry, academic or personal projects.
  • Some technical knowledge and experience, either more foundational (e.g. mathematics, statistics, computer science etc.) or applied (programming, software development etc.).
  • Experience and proficiency developing in Python, including wider system design principles.
  • Some experience developing with agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex etc.).
  • Strong system-design judgement: structuring systems so you retain a clear understanding of how they work, even when you didn't hand-write every line, and a sense of how to test and prove them.


NB: Please only apply if you are eligible for DV security clearance (i.e. you are a sole (not dual) British national with min 10 years continuous UK residency).

Join a global business on its AI transformation journey, leading the identification and delivery of high-impact AI use cases that improve productivity, efficiency and decision-making. You'll work closely with senior stakeholders and Technical AI specialists to turn AI opportunities into real business outcomes while driving adoption and organisational change.

Client Details

Our client, a global industrial organisation, is seeking a Global Product Owner for AI to act as the key link between business functions and emerging AI capabilities.

This role will be responsible for identifying, shaping, prioritising and driving the adoption of AI-powered transformation.

Working closely with business stakeholders, IT leadership and technical AI specialists, you will ensure that initiatives deliver measurable operational value, improve productivity, reduce errors and accelerate business outcomes.

You will develop and implement the AI agenda, developing use cases & product roadmaps, conduct requirements gathering and ensure successful adoption. While technical teams build and maintain the underlying AI platforms and infrastructure, you will determine where AI can create the greatest business impact and ensure delivered solutions achieve sustainable usage and value.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines strong IT transformation/change management capability and a passion for AI technology.

Description

Key Responsibilities
  • Own the end-to-end AI use-case pipeline, from discovery and qualification through to prioritisation and delivery.
  • Partner with business leaders and key stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can deliver measurable business benefits.
  • Facilitate workshops to understand business challenges, redesign processes and define AI-enabled solutions.
  • Evaluate AI opportunities based on value, feasibility, business impact and strategic alignment.
  • Drive adoption and user engagement across deployed AI solutions.
  • Lead AI enablement, awareness and literacy initiatives across the organisation.
  • Establish and maintain governance processes to ensure responsible and compliant AI deployment.
  • Develop business cases, benefit hypotheses and value tracking measures for AI initiatives.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to prioritise AI development activity against delivery capacity.
  • Provide recommendations on project approvals and investment decisions.
  • Continuously evaluate deployed solutions, retiring initiatives that fail to demonstrate adoption or business value.
Key Activities
  • Conduct regular discovery workshops across business functions and operational teams.
  • Manage and maintain the AI use-case backlog and delivery roadmap.
  • Track initiative ownership, progress, adoption levels and realised benefits.
  • Produce regular value and performance reports for senior leadership.
  • Lead AI user communities, champion networks and training programmes.
  • Identify and develop citizen developers and AI champions within the business.
  • Monitor solution adoption and intervene where engagement falls below expectations.
  • Prepare governance and approval documentation for AI initiatives.
  • Communicate evolving AI capabilities and opportunities across the organisation.
Success Measures
  • Number of qualified AI use cases progressing into delivery.
  • Conversion rate from idea through to production deployment.
  • User adoption and engagement across implemented AI solutions.
  • Measurable business value delivered against agreed objectives.
  • Growth in AI usage and capability across the organisation.
  • Expansion of business-led AI development and innovation communities.


Profile

About you:

  • Business-facing: at home in a sales office and on a factory floor, and credible in both.
  • A facilitator: gets a mixed room from problem to validated concept without the loudest voice owning the outcome.
  • Evidence-driven about value: a benefit that cannot be measured is a hypothesis, not a result.
  • Technically literate enough to be credible with engineers without pretending to be one.
  • Works comfortably across cultures and time zones, and travels to sites when the work is there; discovery happens where the process runs.

Professional experience:

  • Five or more years in consulting, transformation or product owner/manager roles, with demonstrable AI use-case delivery.
  • Strong facilitation and design-thinking practice, evidenced by workshops run and concepts that shipped.
  • Adoption and change-management experience; a Microsoft 365 Copilot or comparable enterprise AI rollout is a strong advantage.
  • Value-tracking discipline: baselines, benefit hypotheses and realised-value reporting that survived finance scrutiny.
  • Enough technical literacy to qualify feasibility honestly: knows what an agent, a model and a data boundary are, and what each costs.

Job Offer

  • Salary up to £80,000 plus annual bonus.
  • Generous pension.
  • Highly Flexible working.
  • Opportunity for international travel.
  • Location agnostic in the UK.

AI Engineer (Agentic AI)

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to build real-world AI systems that deliver measurable impact across customer journeys and internal operations. This role is all about turning emerging AI capabilities-LLMs, agentic systems, ML models, workflows, and AI services-into robust, production-ready solutions.



What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and integrate AI applications into end-to-end workflows.
  • Embed agentic AI into customer and operational processes with reliability, resilience, and safe fallback behavior.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations to take AI solutions from concept to production.
  • Establish best practices for orchestration, testing, monitoring, and operational safeguards.
  • Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and translate them into practical, high-value implementations.


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background (Python), with experience delivering production AI or ML-integrated systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI services, or agentic AI frameworks.
  • Practical understanding of AI production concerns: latency, resilience, observability, safety, and maintainability.
  • Systems thinker who collaborates effectively across teams and communicates clearly.
  • Passion for applied AI and agentic systems, with a focus on turning capabilities into tangible outcomes.

Bonus if you have: AWS AI/ML experience, building autonomous workflows, regulated industry exposure, or contributions to the AI community.



Benefits:

  • Training and development budgets
  • A culture of collaboration and growth so your career can become what you want it to be.
  • Hybrid working – balance of remote working and on-site to suit your work/life balance.

Join us and help shape the future of AI-driven systems in a fast-moving, hands-on environment.

I'm partnered with an innovative digital content business at the forefront of AI-generated media.

They are seeking a talented Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor to create engaging, narrative-driven video content using cutting-edge generative AI tools and workflows.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of storytelling, creativity, and emerging technology. You'll take ownership of the entire production process, transforming concepts into polished, cinematic content whilst helping to shape the future of AI-powered video production.

The Role
As a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor, you will be responsible for creating long-form, story-focused content using advanced AI video generation tools and traditional post-production software. Working closely with the Content Lead, you'll drive projects from initial concept through to final delivery, maintaining exceptional visual quality and narrative consistency throughout.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop scripts and creative concepts centred around existing AI-generated characters and intellectual property
  • Produce compelling long-form, narrative-driven video content with a strong emphasis on storytelling, pacing, atmosphere, and visual quality
  • Own end-to-end AI video production workflows, including prompting, generation, editing, compositing, and final delivery
  • Utilise leading AI video platforms including Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and other emerging technologies
  • Maintain character consistency, visual style, and scene continuity across longer-form productions
  • Apply motion graphics, visual effects, colour correction, and post-production techniques to elevate final outputs
  • Continuously experiment with new AI tools, workflows, and production techniques
  • Work autonomously whilst aligning with creative direction and production goals

About You
Essential Experience
  • 4+ years' experience in video production, VFX, motion design, digital art, or a related creative field
  • Demonstrable portfolio showcasing AI-generated video content
  • Hands-on experience with AI video generation tools and workflows
  • Strong knowledge of prompting techniques, content generation pipelines, consistency methods, and post-processing
  • Advanced proficiency with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or equivalent editing software
  • Excellent understanding of cinematic storytelling, editing rhythm, composition, and visual language
  • Experience maintaining character and scene consistency across AI-generated sequences
  • Strong understanding of visual content production from concept through to delivery

Personal Attributes
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Highly self-motivated with strong ownership and accountability
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment
  • Naturally curious and passionate about emerging AI technologies
  • Confident experimenting with new tools and approaches
  • Adaptable, resilient, and open to feedback
  • Able to manage multiple priorities and iterate quickly

What's on Offer?
  • Opportunity to work with some of the most advanced AI video production tools available today
  • High levels of creative ownership and autonomy
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Collaborative and forward-thinking team culture
  • Direct influence on production processes and creative output
  • Exposure to cutting-edge developments within generative AI and digital media

Built a RAG chatbot? Great. Taken an AI solution into production, evaluated its weaknesses and made it genuinely better? Now we're talking.

We're looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to join a growing AI function where the focus is on building intelligent, reliable and scalable solutions that solve real business problems.

This role is for someone who enjoys the difficult engineering challenges behind generative AI: improving retrieval, reducing hallucinations, fine-tuning models and proving that changes genuinely improve performance.

You won't just be experimenting with the latest frameworks. You'll be designing, building, evaluating and improving AI systems that are intended to deliver measurable results.

What will you be working on?

  • Building and optimising production-grade RAG pipelines, including retrieval, chunking, reranking and grounding.
  • Developing advanced GenAI applications and agentic workflows using LangChain, LangGraph and LlamaIndex.
  • Working on model training, fine-tuning, instruction tuning and optimisation.
  • Designing robust model evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, reliability, consistency and overall response quality.
  • Measuring retrieval performance, hallucination rates, groundedness, robustness and safety.
  • Exploring evaluation approaches including BERTScore, human-in-the-loop testing and automated evaluation.
  • Experimenting with models and architectures to improve performance, latency and cost efficiency.
  • Taking ownership of technical solutions from initial design through to production deployment and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborating with engineers and stakeholders to solve complex AI challenges.


What will make you stand out?

  • Strong hands-on Python engineering experience.
  • Proven commercial experience delivering GenAI, LLM or RAG solutions into production.
  • Practical experience using LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or comparable orchestration frameworks.
  • Genuine experience in model evaluation, testing and performance improvement.
  • Exposure to model fine-tuning, adaptation or training, with an understanding of when these approaches are appropriate.
  • Strong understanding of embeddings, vector databases, retrieval architectures and LLM behaviour.
  • The ability to explain your technical decisions, evaluate trade-offs and demonstrate the impact of your work.


Experience with Azure AI Foundry would be advantageous.

Why join?

You'll be joining a business that's actively investing in AI, with the opportunity to own complex technical challenges and directly influence how AI solutions are built and improved.

You'll work closely with an ambitious engineering team, contribute to key architectural decisions and have the space to experiment, challenge existing approaches and deliver meaningful improvements.

We're not looking for someone who can simply connect an LLM to an API. We're looking for an engineer who understands how to make AI accurate, reliable and production-ready.

Sound like you? Let's have a conversation.

Junior Data Analyst – Manchester

We’re working with a growing retail business that’s investing heavily in data and looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join the team.

This isn’t a role where you’ll spend all day building reports and moving on to the next request. They’re looking for someone who enjoys getting under the skin of the data, spotting patterns, understanding what’s driving performance, and helping the business make better decisions as a result.

You’ll work with teams across the business, looking at everything from customer behaviour and sales performance through to operational and commercial trends. The goal is to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations that genuinely influence decision-making.

You’ll still be hands-on with SQL and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, but the real value in this role comes from your ability to interpret the data, tell the story behind it and drive action from your findings.

As the business continues to grow, so will the role. It’s a great opportunity for someone early in their analytics career who wants exposure to stakeholders, the chance to influence decisions, and a clear development path.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Analysing customer, sales and commercial data to identify trends and opportunities
  • Producing insights that help teams make better business decisions
  • Turning analysis into clear recommendations and actionable next steps
  • Building and maintaining dashboards and reports in Power BI
  • Writing SQL queries to extract and analyse data
  • Working closely with stakeholders to understand business challenges and answer key questions
  • Presenting findings in a way that is easy for non-technical teams to understand
  • Continuously looking for ways to improve reporting, analysis and decision-making across the business

What they’re looking for:

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience creating dashboards and visualisations in Power BI, Tableau or a similar tool
  • Pyhton would be a bonus
  • Someone who enjoys analysing data and uncovering the “why” behind the numbers
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders
  • A naturally curious mindset and genuine passion for data
  • The ability to translate analysis into meaningful business recommendations
  • Previous experience in a Data Analyst, Insight Analyst or Reporting Analyst role

Why apply?

  • Salary up to £45K DOE
  • Hybrid working in Manchester, 2 days per week
  • Discounted products/services
  • Health and wellness benefits
  • L&D support
  • Pension
  • Company socials
  • Join a business that genuinely values data-driven decision making
  • Lots of exposure to senior stakeholders
  • Opportunity to shape how insights are used across the business
  • Clear progression as the team and function continue to grow

This role would suit someone who has strong SQL experience and ideally experience with visualisation tools, i.e. Power BI, Tableau or similar. Equally, you’ll be excited by speaking to stakeholders, understanding business problems and using data to influence decisions. The technical side matters, but attitude, curiosity and commercial thinking are just as important.

*You must be based in the Northwest and have commercial experience in an Analyst role. No sponsorship is available for this role*

jobDescription:

Remote

Permanent

About HF

People. Not just lawyers

We’re not your typical law firm – we’re people with a passion for helping our clients and each other achieve the best possible outcomes. We are looking for an experienced and delivery-focused Senior Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Manager to lead a multidisciplinary Agile team delivering change across the Clio Operate platform.

This is not a traditional Scrum Master role focused solely on facilitating Agile ceremonies. We need someone who will take real accountability for delivery, creating an environment where the team can perform effectively while ensuring commitments, risks, dependencies and blockers are actively managed.

You will be expected to understand what the team has committed to, whether delivery is on track and, critically, why it is not progressing when expected. You will challenge constructively, remove obstacles, drive issues through to resolution and escalate where intervention is required.

The successful candidate will combine strong Scrum Master capabilities with many of the responsibilities of an Agile Delivery Manager, providing the leadership, structure, transparency and momentum needed to help the team consistently get things done.

What you’ll be doing

• Take accountability for the team's delivery against agreed Sprint, PI and wider programme commitments.

• Maintain a clear understanding of delivery progress, priorities, dependencies, risks and blockers.

• Identify when delivery is falling behind and proactively establish the underlying cause.

• Constructively challenge the team where progress, ownership or pace is below expectations.

• Drive blockers and impediments through to resolution rather than simply recording or reporting them.

• Escalate issues quickly and appropriately where resolution sits outside the team's control.

• Work closely with Product Owners, engineering, testing, business SMEs and other delivery teams to resolve cross-team dependencies.

• Maintain a strong focus on outcomes and completed work, not simply activity or ceremony.

Agile & Scrum Leadership

• Lead and continuously improve the team's Agile delivery practices.

• Facilitate effective Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Refinement, Sprint Reviews and Retrospectives.

• Ensure Sprint Goals are meaningful, understood and actively managed throughout the Sprint.

• Lead effective PI Planning and delivery against committed PI Objectives.

• Drive high standards around Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, estimation, capacity planning and backlog readiness.

• Use retrospectives and delivery data to identify improvements and ensure agreed actions translate into measurable change.

• Promote accountability and ownership within the team rather becoming the team's task manager.

Delivery Management

• Maintain a clear delivery plan and understand whether upcoming milestones and commitments

• remain achievable.

• Proactively manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and delivery constraints.

• Coordinate dependencies across teams and workstreams.

• Ensure emerging delivery risks are identified early rather than becoming last-minute surprises.

• Work with the Product Owner to ensure the team has sufficient prioritised, refined and delivery-ready work.

• Balance Agile principles with the practical realities of delivery within a complex enterprise programme.

Metrics, Reporting & Governance

• Own accurate and transparent reporting of team delivery performance.

• Use delivery metrics to understand performance and support evidence-based conclusions.

• Translate detailed delivery information into clear executive messages covering progress, confidence, risks, impact and required decisions.

• Ensure reporting provides an honest view of delivery health rather than simply reporting that activity is taking place.

What do I need?

• Significant experience as a Scrum Master and/or Delivery Manager within technology environments.

• Strong practical knowledge of Scrum, Agile and preferably SAFe.

• Experience leading multidisciplinary teams including developers, testers, analysts, platform specialists and Product Owners.

• An understanding of software delivery and the SDLC.

• Experience managing delivery risks, dependencies, blockers and competing priorities.

• Strong delivery reporting and analytical capability.

• Experience using Jira or comparable Agile delivery tooling.

• The ability to interpret delivery metrics and turn data into meaningful management insight.

• Experience producing reporting for senior leadership and governance boards.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

What’s in it for you?

Apart from the competitive salary you’d expect, our package of benefits reflects our values of partnership, innovation, and being real people. We’re committed to creating a dynamic workplace where everyone feels supported, empowered, and part of our success.

You’ll enjoy:

• 25 days’ annual leave (rising to 30 with service) + Holiday Buy Scheme

• Life Insurance & Income Protection

• Private Medical Insurance & Healthcare Cash Plan

• Employee Assistance Programme & Digital GP services

• Pension Scheme

• Electric Car Scheme

• Enhanced Maternity, Paternity & Adoption Leave

• Hybrid & Flexible Working Options

• Discounted Gym Membership & Employee Discount Hub

• Flu & Eyecare Vouchers – and more!

What next?

If HF sounds like a place where you could belong, we'd love to learn more about you!

As a Senior Data Governance Analyst here at Together you will provide subject matter expertise and leadership in the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Together’s Data Governance Framework. You will drive data ownership, stewardship, data quality, metadata management and governance maturity across the organisation as a recognised expert in the data, processes and controls.

As a trusted adviser to the business and technical and delivery stakeholders alike, you will be leading governance initiatives; influencing decision making and embedding practical data management controls that support regulatory compliance, operational effectiveness and strategic business outcomes.

This is also a great opportunity to be involved in data architecture activities including contributing to data modelling, source-to-target mapping, data structure definition and the assessment of data impacts across change. Crucially, as an experienced Senior member of the Team, you will be supporting our Data Governance Analysts and Data Stewards with guidance and mentorship.

jobTitle: EMIR / MiFIR Transformation Business Analyst - G MASS Consulting
jobDescription:
We’re partnering with a Regulatory Reporting Consultancy, as it builds out the transformation and implementation expertise behind its client projects.


This is a client-facing role. You will be deployed into institutional clients - typically banks and financial institutions - to implement technology: establishing their existing reporting obligations, understanding what they currently report and from where, and mapping that landscape onto the specification.


The work is transformation-led. Clients typically arrive with their data spread across a number of separate systems, and the first task is to make sense of that estate: tracing where each reportable attribute originates, identifying what is missing, and building the mapping that allows the client to meet its EMIR and MiFIR obligations. The role combines hands-on business analysis with project management, so you will be in the detail of the data while also driving the engagement forward.


Engagements typically run for several months and frequently longer. Candidates based anywhere in Europe will be considered, provided they work within a European time zone. The first engagement is expected to begin early in the new year.


Key Responsibilities



  • Act as the business analyst and project lead on implementation engagements, working alongside client teams.
  • Establish and document each client’s reporting obligations and current reporting arrangements across EMIR and MiFIR.
  • Analyse client data across multiple source systems, tracing where each reportable attribute originates and how it flows.
  • Map the client’s data landscape to the reporting specification, identifying gaps, ambiguities, and attributes that require sourcing elsewhere.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into practical data requirements, drawing on an understanding of how the industry operationalises EMIR and MiFIR obligations.
  • Plan and drive the engagement, tracking progress, managing dependencies, and keeping delivery to schedule.
  • Identify where client data quality or availability would affect accurate reporting, and define what is needed to close those gaps.
  • Lead working sessions with client stakeholders across operations, technology, and compliance to resolve mapping questions and interpretive issues.
  • Produce clear mapping documentation, business requirements, and supporting analysis for both client and internal use.
  • Support testing and validation of reporting outputs ahead of client go-live.
  • Help shape the direction of the analysis, with scope to lead or co-lead the engagement.

Requirements



  • Hands-on business analysis experience within regulatory reporting, gained within financial services or with a platform or vendor serving the sector.
  • Strong working knowledge of EMIR and MiFIR reporting - the data each regime requires, and how firms operationalise those obligations in practice.
  • Demonstrable data mapping expertise: tracing reportable attributes across source systems and mapping them to a target specification.
  • Experience of large, complex system implementations or migrations - order management, trading, risk, or similar enterprise platforms, including implementations beyond regulatory reporting.
  • A combination of business analysis and project management capability, comfortable in the detail of the data while keeping an engagement moving to schedule.
  • Strong data analysis capability, with the ability to make sense of a fragmented data estate and evidence conclusions clearly.
  • A confident client-facing manner, with the credibility to work alongside senior stakeholders at an institutional client.
  • Broader European regulatory reporting exposure is an advantage.
  • Based within a European time zone, with fluent written and spoken English.

Benefits


Length: Initial 12-month contract

jobTitle: Field Customer Success Specialist (Field Service Engineer), Vending Technology
jobDescription:
ABOUT THE JOB

When a customer's own technicians have tried everything and the machine still won't behave, you're the one they call.

Our client makes vending machines and the payment systems that go in them, with manufacturing in the UK. Once a machine is sold, the operator who bought it runs it and maintains it with their own service team. So by the time a problem reaches you, the manual has been followed and the obvious fixes have failed. What's left is the interesting part: a component that has drifted out of tolerance, a software change with a side effect, a third-party payment device that isn't talking to the machine the way it should.

Your job is to find the real cause, not only to get the machine running again. Often you'll solve it remotely, which is how the customer would like it: a machine that's down is losing them revenue, and on some sites they're on the clock with their own customers. Sometimes you'll be on site with them. You own the problem from the first call to the fix. You tell the customer honestly where things stand, bring what you've found back into the business, and work with quality, supply chain, and engineering until there's a solution that holds up in the field.

You make sure nobody has to solve it twice. What you learn becomes a troubleshooting guide, a training session, a short video, or a better workflow in Salesforce, so the next customer gets to the answer faster. The team is working out how AI can help with that, and you'd have a real hand in it.

You'll be part of a team that supports customers across Europe, working alongside sales, engineering, and customer service. Training customers' technicians, support new launches, and feed what you hear in the field back to product design.

THE MANDATE

Our client is not looking for a repair technician who works through the manual and stops there. The customer has already done that. They're not looking for a salesperson either, or for someone who needs to be pointed in a direction before they'll move.

They're seeking someone who can troubleshoot electromechanical equipment and the software that runs it, keep going until they reach the root cause, and stay pragmatic about when a fix is good enough to take back to the field. The right person is steady with a customer who's under pressure and wants an answer now, confident enough to tell them what the best solution really is, and independent enough to set their own direction and sense-check it.

Duties and responsibilities
  • Give customers technical support, remotely and on site, and be the escalation point when their own teams can't resolve an issue
  • Troubleshoot and resolve configuration, installation, and operating problems, including equipment that isn't right out of the box
  • Lead root cause investigations with engineering, quality, operations, and product teams, and see recurring issues through to a lasting fix
  • Manage your cases in Salesforce: track progress, keep accurate records, and spot the patterns in what keeps coming up
  • Deliver certified training and onboarding for customers and their technicians, so they can operate, maintain, and troubleshoot the machines themselves
  • Support new product introductions, evaluations, and customer pilots, from installation planning and commissioning to rollout and early-life support, coordinating customer readiness with the teams involved
  • Write and keep current the user guides, service bulletins, technical procedures, troubleshooting documents, and customer instructions
  • Produce training videos and digital learning content that help customers help themselves
  • Gather customer feedback, pick out the concerns that keep recurring, whether about the product, its quality, how usable it is, or the service, and report them in a structured way to the teams who can act on them
  • Look for better ways to deliver support, including where AI and better tools can help
  • Help retain and grow the key customer accounts in your territory

LOCATION & WORK MODEL

  • Field-based in the UK, working from home between customer visits
  • Regular travel across the UK and Ireland. A call can come from Glasgow as easily as from London.
  • Ideally you live along the M4 corridor west of London or within reach of Manchester, about two hours from one of the company's UK sites, which you'll use for customer training
Experience and qualifications

Essential:

  • A background in technical support, field service, customer success, or a customer-facing engineering role
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills across electromechanical equipment and software
  • Experience delivering training and presentations to customers
  • Able to explain technical ideas to technical and non-technical people alike
  • Excellent customer relationship skills, including with customers who are under pressure
  • Clear written communication and good documentation habits
  • Comfortable working independently and managing your own priorities
  • A full driving licence valid in the UK. The role involves regular driving to customer sites across the UK and Ireland in a company vehicle.
  • Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Proof will be required before employment starts.

Desirable:

  • Experience in payment, kiosk, vending, coffee, beverage, or other electromechanical technology
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce
  • Experience making instructional or digital training content, including video
  • An interest in using AI to improve troubleshooting, documentation, and customer support
  • French or German. Spanish is also useful.
